headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.5 Instant as New Default ChatGPT Model
deck: Faster foundation model replaces GPT-5.3 Instant, emphasizing speed and security testing through trusted partnerships.
summary: On May 5, 2026, OpenAI released GPT-5.5 Instant, a new foundation model that immediately replaced GPT-5.3 Instant as the default ChatGPT experience. The launch follows OpenAI's rigorous safety evaluation framework, which included feedback from nearly 200 trusted early-access partners and targeted testing for advanced cybersecurity capabilities. This transition continues OpenAI's pattern of model updates, following the February 2026 deprecation of GPT-4o.
